en.headline: ICAC charges man, 80, over alleged 10,000 dollar bribe offer
en.dek: Prosecutors say he offered cash to a Yau Tsim Mong councillor to press a pastor into a meeting. He is due in court on Friday.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption has charged an 80-year-old man with offering an advantage to a public servant, after an allegation that he tried to pay a district councillor 10,000 dollars.

The defendant, Fong Chin-chung, is accused of one count under section 4(1)(a) of the Prevention of Bribery Ordinance. The charge alleges that on 3 August 2026 he offered 10,000 dollars to Yau Tsim Mong district councillor Li Ka-hin as a reward for Li, in his public capacity, directing an assistant to help locate a pastor and arrange a meeting between the defendant and the pastor.

According to the case as set out by the commission, Fong approached Li in early July through the district council's meet-the-public scheme, then later visited the councillor's office and asked that a folder be passed on. The folder was said to contain 10,000 dollars in cash and a signed letter asking Li to instruct an assistant to coerce the pastor into meeting him over a private matter. Li rejected the offer and reported the case to the district council. The ICAC later received a report and investigated.
Fong was charged on Wednesday and granted bail. He is due to plead on Friday at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts. He has not been convicted, and the allegations remain to be tested in court.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴八旬翁涉向區議員提供一萬元利益
zh.dek: 控方指他向油尖旺區議員提供現金，意圖促成與一名牧師會面。案件星期五在西九龍裁判法院答辯。
body: 廉政公署落案起訴一名80歲男子，控告他涉嫌向公職人員提供利益。案情指他試圖向一名區議員提供一萬元現金。
被告方展崇被控一項罪名，違反《防止賄賂條例》第4（1）（a）條。控罪指他於2026年8月3日向油尖旺區議員李家軒提供一萬元，作為李家軒以公職人員身分指示助理協助尋找一名牧師，並安排被告與該牧師會面的報酬。
廉署交代的案情指，被告於7月初經區議會「會見市民計劃」向李家軒求助，其後到訪區議員辦事處，要求轉交一個文件夾。文件夾內據稱有現金一萬元，以及一封由被告簽署的信，要求李家軒指示助理以脅逼手段安排該名牧師與他會面，以處理一件私人事務。李家軒拒絕收受，並向區議會匯報。廉署其後接獲舉報並調查。
被告星期三被起訴，獲准保釋，星期五在西九龍裁判法院答辯。他仍未被定罪，控罪有待法庭審理。
